A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same KLASS research work, with complete, readable main text and Appendices A–G. Text comparison and rendered-page checks support comparison of the methods, equations, figures, tables, and proofs.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on reasoning, text generation, image generation, and molecular generation, together with ablations and computational-overhead measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and reports revised MAUVE results in Tables 2 and 10.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same confidence-and-KL stability criteria, history window, parallel unmasking, and fallback procedure. The fixed-budget adaptations described in Appendix D are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use GSM8K, MATH500, HumanEval, MBPP-sanitized, OpenWebText, ImageNet class-conditioned generation, and QM9 molecular generation. No task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including the reasoning samplers, AR/SEDD/D3PM/MDLM text baselines, image and molecular baselines, and Appendix E's Top-k Margin and Entropy comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 6.2 and Appendix D.2.1 change the MAUVE reference description from 1,000 held-out OpenWebText test-split segments to 1,000 held-out OpenWebText segments. The PDFs do not establish whether reference selection changed or only its description. Other stated settings, sample counts, and metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The confidence/KL threshold, parallel-unmasking, history-length, and temperature analyses in Section 6.5 and Appendix D.5 are unchanged. Computational-overhead measurements and Appendix F's qualitative examples are also retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both versions retain three-run reporting for Dream and three fixed random seeds with mean ± standard deviation for text generation. Revised MAUVE means and standard deviations change result values, not the uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: The revisions are confined to MDLM and KLASS MAUVE entries in Tables 2 and 10. Table 10 changes MDLM from 0.0043 ± 0.0002 to 0.115 ± 0.033 and KLASS from 0.242 ± 0.082 to 0.179 ± 0.041. The reported gap narrows substantially, and MDLM moves above SEDD and D3PM; KLASS remains the highest-scoring diffusion sampler. Other metrics and experimental results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Proposition 5.3, and its Appendix A proof are identical. The sampling formulations reviewed in Appendix C are also unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free adaptive sampling, up to 2.78× acceleration, improved generation quality, and applicability across modalities.

C2.justification: The interpretations of stability, parallel unmasking, and generation quality remain unchanged, including Section 6.2's discussion despite the revised MAUVE values. Appendix G retains the same scalability and hyperparameter-search limitations.

D1.justification: Removing 'test split' from Section 6.2 and Appendix D.2.1 makes the MAUVE reference-data description less specific. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 56 reference entries are retained, and Section 2 and Appendix C preserve the same discussion and positioning relative to prior work. Bibliography pagination changes do not alter its content.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short funding Acknowledgments section before the references, updates the version/date stamp, and shortens the two OpenWebText reference-data descriptions. The scientific narrative and remaining section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The new acknowledgments block shifts the bibliography across pages 10–15, and Table 10 becomes slightly narrower. Figures, table structures, captions, and numbering remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The MAUVE revisions in Tables 2 and 10 substantially narrow the reported advantage over MDLM, but neither PDF explains whether they correct errors or reflect different reference data. Funding disclosure adds transparency, while removing the explicit test-split designation reduces reproducibility detail. With the remaining scientific content unchanged, the PDFs do not establish a reliable net improvement or deterioration.
